li.label: I Remember everything i did, what i have done
li.description: Every hour I spent as one of them is still inside my head. I remember the faces. I remember the begging. I remember how easily I stopped listening. The virus is gone, but it gave the memories back—sharp, whole, and impossible to look away from. I did those things. I chose them. Now I have to carry every one of them for the rest of my life.
